evidence: Locally executed 64-particle GPU comparisons; complete raw reports remain in ignored output directories
scope: Forward-only fixed QA Boozer field, unchanged Dopri8 tableau, embedded error, I controller, save times and stopping surface; all successful cases agree bitwise
compiler_measurements: One tracing/lowering and executable-compilation measurement per case per pass. Persistent JAX compilation cache disabled; other compiler caches and initialization effects are not guaranteed absent.
curation: Retains every timing sample, phase, compiled-buffer estimate, check, source hash, error and orbit launch resource; omits unrelated GPU resource listings.
earlier_failures: Pass 1 includes an unsupported boolean reduce_and candidate; pass 2 includes unsupported scan-unroll parameters. Those forms were removed from the driver. Explicit fixed-size Horner blocks succeeded in pass 3.

checks: linear exit, initial events and duplicate saves

passes.memory_scope: Compiled buffers per executable. Device allocator peaks are cumulative across selected cases, not per-case peak VRAM. No executed-spill or instruction-stall counters.
